== Biography ==
'''Barbara Glasgow''' was baptised at Glasgow High Kirk on 21 October 1617, a lawful daughter of '''[[Glasgow-1099|George Glasgow]]''' and '''[[Stewart-65226|Margaret Stewart]]'''.<ref name="BarbaraBaptism">Glasgow High Kirk baptism register, baptism of Barbara Glasgow, 21 October 1617, lawful daughter of George Glasgow and Margaret Stewart; witnesses Michael Broun and Thomas Stewart, ''ScotlandsPeople'', reference volume 1/2353.</ref>

Her exact date of birth has not been identified. She was born on or before the date of her baptism.

No later record has yet been identified with sufficient certainty to establish Barbara's marriage, children, residence, or date and place of death.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1099]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Barbara’s 21 October 1617 Glasgow High Kirk entry names George Glasgow and Margaret Stewart, with Michael Broun and Thomas Stewart as witnesses. The full couple matches the selected family.

Confident for this child. The separate Edinburgh Barbara of June 1617 is not merged, and the witnesses’ kinship is not assumed.

Next useful test: Compare the original Glasgow entry if the Edinburgh namesake is proposed.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1102 Glasgow High Kirk baptism register, baptism of Barbara Glasgow, 21 October 1617, lawful daughter of George Glasgow and Margaret Stewart; witnesses Michael Broun and Thomas Stewart, ScotlandsPeople, reference volume 1/2353.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Parentage ===

Barbara's baptism directly identifies George Glasgow and Margaret Stewart as her parents.<ref name="BarbaraBaptism" />

The witnesses were Michael Broun and Thomas Stewart. Their relationships to Barbara and her parents have not been established.

=== Conflicting baptism index ===

A FamilySearch index associated with another Barbara Glasgow profile reportedly gives a baptism dated 29 June 1617 at Edinburgh to parents of the same names.

That index conflicts with the more detailed Glasgow High Kirk transcription dated 21 October 1617. The original entries have not been compared, so the Edinburgh date and place should not be applied to this profile unless the discrepancy is resolved.

Possible explanations include:

* an indexing or transcription error;
* two separate baptismal events;
* two children of the same name;
* two different couples with matching names; or
* an incorrect attachment on the other profile.

No conclusion should be drawn without inspecting the original parish-register images.

=== Distinct from other women named Barbara Glasgow ===

This Barbara cannot be the adult Barbara Glasgow who was already the mother of Catharine Little in 1611. A person baptised in 1617 could not have borne a child six years earlier.

She should not be merged with:

* [[Glasgow-567|Barbara Glasgow]], represented as an adult in Edinburgh in 1611;
* [[Glasgow-3182|Barbara Glasgow]], who married at South Leith in 1611; or
* [[Glasgow-3302|Barbara Glasgow]], who married at Edinburgh in 1616.

The chronology alone excludes those identifications unless the 1617 baptism has been attached to the wrong child.

=== Further research ===

Useful remaining records include:

* the original Glasgow High Kirk baptism image;
* the original record underlying the conflicting FamilySearch index;
* burial records for Barbara;
* marriage records after about 1633;
* testaments or property records naming George Glasgow's children; and
* records identifying Michael Broun and Thomas Stewart.
